name: nop-treesitter
description: Pure-Java Tree-sitter runtime for the Nop platform. Replace JNI/FFM dependency with a Java reimplementation of lib/src/*.c (parser, lexer, subtree arena, query, cursor, external scanner VM). Use gotreesitter's parse-table extraction approach so 200+ upstream grammars load from binary blobs. Roadmap: ai-dev/backlog/nop-treesitter-roadmap.md. Module: nop-treesitter (single module for items 1-11; split into api/core/loader if size grows). Hard constraints: NO JNI, NO FFM, NO native lib loading, NO GraalVM-specific features. JDK 17 baseline. Always verify with upstream test/corpus fixtures — never rely solely on hand-written tests.
